Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded the maternal grandmother was “Frederica of Hanover,” confusing lineage generations. Frederica is Queen Sofía’s mother (thus Froilán’s maternal great-grandmother), while multiple sources cited indicate Froilán is the maternal-line grandson of King Juan Carlos I and Queen Sofía of Spain, making Queen Sofía his maternal grandmother.
